title: Would do it again!
text: This was a family vacation.  Philippe is very knowledgeable, informative and passionate about Catalunya.  We received a great overview of the area and also learned about Three Kings day.  He was at Green Bike well before the tour began and gave us his full attention.  We appreciate Philippe coming out during the Spanish holiday! The bike tour allowed us to see a lot of Barcelona.  We always felt safe under his direction and the city is set up for bicycling.
author: C5818LCpaulaw

title: Best way to know Barcelona
text: It was a pleasant journey with Philippe to ride the bike to feel the city. He is very knowledgable, introducing the city in an interesting and easy to understand way to us. Strongly recommend to add this experience to your trip!
author: FionaT1491

title: Great introduction to Barcelona
text: Jordi was professional and fun. Shared a lot of information about Barcelona, especially about gaudi. Highly recommend his tour.
author: hekilio

title: Wonderful Barcelona & Gaudi tour!
text: Our group of 4 was treated to a wonderful walking tour of Barcelona with a focus on Gaudi from Philippe. He was very friendly, knowledgeable and took us to wonderful places. After Sagrada Familia he suggested a fantastic spot for lunch near Sagrada. We will recommend taking a tour with Philippe to all our friends & family and will book again next time we are back in Barcelona. Thank you Philippe!
author: 44martiv

title: Great tour for Gaudí and much more
text: Philippe provided intriguing stories about Gaudi, interesting information about the history of Catalunya, and helpful insight into the culture and perspectives of the locals. We appreciated that he pointed out the highlights of the Sagrada Familia that we should not miss before we went in for that part of the tour. The bike ride was lovely and a really fun way to get around the city. Philippe has a wry sense of humor and liked questions and banter. We would definitely recommend him as a guide!
author: WhiskeyMcJoy

title: Great tour - highly recommended
text:
Amazing tour, we were a group of both teens and adults and had a great time.
Our guide was interesting with a personal touch and very attentive to our wants and pace
author: Wanderer33673869107

title: Best tour guide and experience in Barcelona!
text: We had a fantastic time biking around the old city and along the beach with our guide, Lounis. author: cyndil935

title: Terrific experience!
text:
From the start, Phillipe treated us as old friends. With just two of us, we felt we received a plethora of information and knowledge of what we toured/visited.  The time spent was filled with not only the history of Barcelona, but also local tidbits, personal conversations and even recommendations of what to visit/eat during our stay. 

Wish we could take Phillipe along with us through the rest of journey!
author: ErinW289

title: Barcelona By Bike
text: Fab tour, Agni was really great. Highly recommended. Her knowledge and love of Barcelona really comes through. Great way to check out the highlights in a fun easy interesting way - do it!
author: simonbJ8354RP

title: Lounis is your guy for a customized bike tour
text: We booked a last minute family barcelona bike tour with Lounis, which he customized to the needs of our family, which has a big age range. He arranged the rental of bikes at an easy to find location, and off we went! We saw all the main sights of Barcelona, stopped at a market for tasting food, cruised the beach, took pictures at La sagrada familia and even saw some Gaudi. The hours flew by as we cruised around and learned the history of Barcelona. Lounis is easy going and confident, he knows Barcelona and we loved touring the city with him.
